name: Santiago Betancur Duque
summary: Senior Software Engineer shipping fast, accessible and secure web products end to end: React, Next.js and Angular frontends, Spring Boot services on AWS.
about: I'm a Computer Engineer and full-stack developer from Medellín, Colombia, shipping production software at Pragma since 2024, from React, Next.js and Angular interfaces to reactive Spring Boot services on AWS.

A problem solver, curious by nature: I dig into the business need, design the right solution and build it with Clean Architecture, EDA and DDD, with measurable results in performance, security and SEO.
I mentored 3 editions of Pragma's full-stack bootcamp (30+ students hired) and co-founded the Frontend chapter's AI initiative. 2x AWS Certified: Cloud Practitioner and AI Practitioner.

highlights: Promoted from intern (Feb 2024) to Senior Software Engineer (Mar 2026), delivering end-to-end solutions for the financial sector, content platforms and internal tools.

Supported the tech lead in designing and building an internal AI agent on Slack (AWS Bedrock, Lambda, RDS + pgvector, Terraform) that automates IT, SAP and security workflows and company-wide knowledge search.

Designed and delivered a public website end to end on my own (Next.js 15 SSG, React 19, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL on AWS): Core Web Vitals 94–100, 96%+ unit test coverage and a perfect SonarQube score on frontend and backend.
Contributed to +22.66% new users, +29.25% engaged sessions and +34.45% interaction time on a high-traffic content platform (Gatsby, GraphQL, Contentful) in three months.
Remediated critical vulnerabilities from external security audits (DAST/SAST) for a financial-sector client, migrated reCAPTCHA v2 to v3 Enterprise and hardened the app with React Server Components.
Built CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps → AWS S3/CloudFront), migrated 330+ unit tests and standardized security, versioning and documentation practices adopted by multiple teams.
